changelogs:
1. Faster Startup — Optimized loading for near-instant startup.
2. Smoother UI — Reduced CPU usage and improved rendering.
3. Smart FPS — Uncapped while active, 30 FPS when minimized or launching.
4. Lazy Token Refresh — Microsoft tokens refresh only when needed.
5. Dynamic 2D Skins — Added lightweight interactive skin previews.
6. Smarter Play Button — Disabled until accounts are fully loaded and validated.
7. Cleaner Skin Gallery — Removed unnecessary skin filenames.
8. 64×32 Skins Fixed — Fixed legacy skin rendering issues.
